content:
Introducing something brand new today: Cibby, a beautifully designed iOS app tailored for collectors of physical video games.

The app is developed by Michael Flarup, who has a strong track record in rich software design.

According to the website: "Cibby is an app made for people who love physical games. Explore and rediscover your collection with stunning interactive 3D effects."

It has a large, modern Delicious Library-style feel.
